tools.name: identifiers_phone-e164-validate
tools.description: Normalise and validate a phone number with bundled libphonenumber metadata. Returns validity, E.164, region, calling code, and number type when known. Not a live carrier lookup. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/identifiers/phone-e164-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not

tools.name: identifiers_gtin-checksum-validate
tools.description: Validate GTIN-8, GTIN-12, GTIN-13, or GTIN-14 check digits with the published GS1 algorithm. Company prefix ownership is not looked up. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/identifiers/gtin-checksum-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: identifiers_isbn-issn-validate
tools.description: Validate ISBN-10, ISBN-13, or ISSN check characters after stripping spaces and hyphens. Bibliographic metadata is not looked up. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/identifiers/isbn-issn-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: identifiers_eori-format-validate
tools.description: Validate Economic Operators Registration and Identification (EORI) shape: ISO country prefix plus up to 15 alphanumeric characters. Does not confirm the number is issued. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/identifiers/eori-format-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: identifiers_address-parse-normalize
tools.description: Heuristically split a free-text address into street, locality, region, postal code, and country hints. No postal directory is used. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/identifiers/address-parse-normalize. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: identifiers_unit-ucum-convert
tools.description: Convert a numeric value between a small bundled UCUM / alias unit subset (length, mass, volume, time, temperature). Incommensurable units return converted=null. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/identifiers/unit-ucum-convert. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: identifiers_us-zcta-geocode
tools.description: Resolve a US 5-digit ZIP to its Census ZIP Code Tabulation Area (ZCTA) internal point and land/water area from the vendored 2026 Gazetteer. Optional toZip returns great-circle distance. Not a street-address geocoder. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/identifiers/us-zcta-geocode. An unpaid call returns

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "identifiers" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: identifiers_gtin-checksum-validate, identifiers_isbn-issn-validate · Public sink: identifiers_phone-e164-validate, identifiers_gtin-checksum-validate, identifiers_isbn-issn-validate, identifiers_eori-format-validate, identifiers_address-parse-normalize, identifiers_unit-ucum-convert, identifiers_us-zcta-geocode · Destructive: identifiers_phone-e164-validate, identifiers_gtin-checksum-validate, identifiers_isbn-issn-validate, identifiers_eori-format-validate, identifiers_address-parse-normalize, identifiers_unit-ucum-convert, identifiers_us-zcta-geocode.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: identifiers_gtin-checksum-validate, identifiers_isbn-issn-validate · Public sink: identifiers_phone-e164-validate, identifiers_gtin-checksum-validate, identifiers_isbn-issn-validate, identifiers_eori-format-validate, identifiers_address-parse-normalize, identifiers_unit-ucum-convert, identifiers_us-zcta-geocode · Destructive: identifiers_phone-e164-validate, identifiers_gtin-checksum-validate, identifiers_isbn-issn-validate, identifiers_eori-format-validate, identifiers_address-parse-normalize, identifiers_unit-ucum-convert, identifiers_us-zcta-geocode

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
